description: Simulated 5g Network Traffic Dataset is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Matthew Anderson, Denver Conger (Idaho National Lab. (INL), Idaho Falls, ID (United States)). This is a dataset of 5G network traffic for use with machine learning tools to benchmark attack detection capabilities for multiple different models. The dataset contains simulated normal and attack 5G network traffic. There is no software in this dataset, only simulated network traffic data. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
